snippet.title: Urban Strife | 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Urban Strife has left Early Access. Version 1.0 is available now on Steam.

MicroProse and White Pond Games present the full release of Urban Strife, a hybrid of tactical RPG, survival simulator, and turn based strategy set in a devastated corner of the American South. Recruit survivors, rebuild a struggling community, forge uneasy alliances, and fight to protect everything you have built against ruthless factions and overwhelming undead hordes.

Version 1.0 brings the complete story campaign, deep turn based tactical combat with realistic ballistics, shelter building and survival systems, faction politics with real consequences, and massive zombie hordes powered by a simultaneous movement system. It all leads to the long awaited final siege, where you must defend Urban Shelter against the massive Atlanta Horde.

After months of community driven development, this is Urban Strife as it was meant to be played.

Play now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/710230/Urban_Strife/
